seeded.name: Seeded
seeded.summary: Hashes with a secret seed chosen for each fight, so an enemy that searches for collisions against the public seed gets nothing.

steady.name: Steady
steady.summary: For 10 percent more Space, a structure becomes steadier: Count-Min counts conservatively and overshoots far less, though it can no longer take deletes back, and LogLog averages only its smallest registers and becomes SuperLogLog, cutting its error.

fading.name: Fading
fading.summary: Old information decays: the Bloom Filter's bits become small counters that count down as new values arrive, so it never fills up and deleted values fade, at the price of forgetting values that were inserted long ago (false negatives).
